summary: ARCHON SEASON-2 RAID LISTS LANDED: raid consensus 3 -> 4 sources, 21 letters recut, 3 unrated, 10 one-band moves. Murlok + Mythicstats recut; Bloodmallet is MID2-partial.

sources.detail: All 6 live pages re-fetched by direct browser-UA GET, HTTP 200, 192-340 KB. Parsed from the single <table class="tier-list">: the first <td> of each row is the letter and each tier-list-entry's FIRST img alt is looked up WHOLE against the roster, never split at a space - the rule that keeps the six two-word-class specs matchable. Per-page counts printed and reconciled against the 27+7+6=40 roster shape BEFORE merging: raid 27/7/6 + M+ 27/7/6 = 80 assignments, 0 unmatched, and apply-ratings was re-run to prove the match (the git diff on data/specs.json stayed empty for this source). ZERO tier moves, raid and M+ alike, for the THIRD night running. Era read from each page's own title AND body, never a substring count: four titles self-identify Patch 12.1 / Season 2, and two carry a stale-era title over a Season-2 body - the raid HEALER page ("Patch 12.0.7 / Midnight", whose ranking body opens "for Midnight Season 2" and whose changelog top entry reads "Further updated for Midnight Season 2 launch after the first few live tests") and the raid DPS page ("Midnight (12.1)"). Body over title, the blue-tracker precedent; Devourer present in both DPS lists. seasonVerified stays s2 on all six and no value changed, so freeze-season.mjs has nothing to do (and on the runner it is the publish job's step, never the agent's). published re-read from each page's JSON-LD dateModified rather than carried forward and unchanged, agreeing 6/6 with published-evidence/evidence.json: raid DPS 2026-08-16, raid healer 08-13, raid tank 08-08, M+ DPS/healer/tank all 08-16. Page snapshots advanced 08-23 -> 08-24.

Both pages re-fetched live, HTTP 200, 159/166 KB. Parsed from the tier__title MARKUP blocks (the anchor is class="tier__title"[^>]*> and each block runs to the next such anchor); each entry's data-original-title is the "Spec Class" string, looked up whole. Raid 4 tier blocks / 40 rows, M+ 40 rows, 0 roster-matching unmatched, 0 tier moves. The M+ page again carries 8 tier blocks - 4 spec tiers plus 4 dungeon-difficulty blocks - and the extras were rejected by ROSTER MATCH rather than by position: Altar of Fangs, Den of Nalorakk, Kings' Rest, Murder Row, Ruby Life Pools, Temple of Sethraliss, The Blinding Vale and Voidscar Arena all fail to map, which is the intended behaviour. Era verified from the ranking body, not the title: the raid page reads "the Midnight Season 2 Raid, The Venomous Abyss", the M+ page "Method's Mythic+ Spec and Dungeon Tier List for Midnight Season 2" under Tactyks' byline; Devourer present on both. seasonVerified stays s2 on both, unchanged. Method's in-body dates are unchanged from 08-22 - "Last Updated 10th August 2026" (raid) and "13th August 2026" (M+) - and are still NOT written to sources.json, because fetch-published.mjs does not cover method and a stored published value there would sit permanently un-cross-checked by the published gate; that remains an owner call. Page snapshots advanced 08-23 -> 08-24.

All 6 pages re-fetched with the FULL browser header set (a UA-only request is Cloudflare-403; r.jina.ai stays untried, it is IP-403 on /guide/* since 2026-08-03), HTTP 200, 73-339 KB. Parsed by unescaping backslash-slash to slash across the WHOLE document FIRST and then searching for [tier-list=rows] ... [/tier-list], selecting the block with the most [spec-badge=] hits rather than anchoring on WH.markup.printHtml( - the anchor that returned 0 rows off the raid-healer decoy in the 08-01 incident. Exactly one block per page; badge counts 27/7/6 raid and 27/7/6 M+ = 80, 0 unmatched, ZERO tier moves. Tier labels parsed with tolerant whitespace: S/A/B/C on the three raid pages, S/A/B/C on M+ healer, A+/A/B/C on M+ DPS (the documented A+, still no S-tier spec in that cut) and S/A/B on M+ tank. All six titles self-identify Season 2 and the bodies agree (S2/12.1 mentions run 49-103 against 10-26 for S1/12.0). published re-read per page from JSON-LD and unchanged, matching published-evidence/evidence.json 6/6: raid DPS 2026-08-14, raid healer 08-18, raid tank 08-14, M+ DPS/healer/tank all 08-18. seasonVerified stays s2 on all six, no value changed. Page snapshots advanced 08-23 -> 08-24.

THE SEASON-2 RAID REBUILD LANDED TONIGHT, and this is the recomposition the transition plan predicted. All 6 aggregate pages re-fetched, HTTP 200, 52-92 KB, parsed from <script id="__NEXT_DATA__"> at props.pageProps.page.specTierListSection.tierLists (NOT page.tierLists), entries resolved from each entry's icon "Class-Spec" token rather than the display name, with tiers[].entries treated as a list OF LISTS. RAID (metric "throughput"): after three weeks of empty lists the three raid pages returned 24 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank = 37 entries, 0 unmatched, alongside a specRankingsSection table that repopulated with the same 37 rows. Era-verified BEFORE merging and it is genuinely Season 2, three ways: page.description reads "tier list for The Venomous Abyss ... in 12.1", specRankingsSection.title reads "DPS Rankings for Mythic The Venomous Abyss", and Devourer is present in the DPS list. seasonVerified therefore advanced s1 -> s2 on all three raid pages - the observation, not a convenience: the letters Archon publishes now describe the live season, so DECISION 1 puts them back into the raid consensus. 21 raid letters were recut against the stored Season-1 ones (5 A->S, 3 up one band, 4 down one, Holy Paladin S->B, Preservation C->A, Blood DK S->A, Discipline C->B) and THREE specs are absent from Archon's S2 raid list entirely - Fire Mage, Frost Mage and Affliction Warlock - which were written as EXPLICIT NULL rather than left standing, because a stale Season-1 letter under an s2-verified source is exactly the two-seasons-in-one-number lie the season gate exists to prevent; they now read "-" and average 3 sources instead of 4. M+ (metric "score"): 27/7/6 = 40 entries, 0 unmatched, and 17 letters moved on the third consecutive upstream recut. Real recut, not a parse artifact, proven three ways on the same fetch: every score rose (Arms 2985->3037, Assassination 2986->3031, Arcane 2975->3005), parses rose with them (Arms 324,536->404,296) and the page total went 2,353,508 -> 3,082,472; lastUpdated advanced 2026-08-22T12:00:00Z -> 2026-08-23T12:00:00Z on all six pages. Eleven of the moves are S->A as the S band narrowed from 12 specs to 7 under Archon's own clustering. DOWNSTREAM the two halves together produced 10 consensus letter moves, ALL one band and none two-band (raid: Frost DK A->B, Marksmanship B->A, Windwalker A->B, Prot Paladin B->A, Discipline S->A+, Elemental B->A, Prot Warrior B->A; M+: Preservation B->A, Marksmanship A->B, Fury A->B), against anomaly limits of 25 total / 6 two-band - the gate is not tripped, so no ack is proposed. The raid consensus now reads 4 sources for 37 specs and 3 for the three Archon leaves unrated. Survivability is reported separately and is still empty.

Archon's Season-2 encounter rebuild is HALF LANDED and was deliberately NOT merged. All 17 encounters were enumerated from the aggregate pages' encounterOptions (9 raid bosses: Nek'zali, Sentinels, Vashnik, Explorers, Sszorak, The Twin Fangs, The Coiled Altar, Ula'tek, Nymrissa; 8 dungeons: Altar of Fangs, Den of Nalorakk, Kings' Rest, Murder Row, Ruby Life Pools, Sethraliss, The Blinding Vale, Voidscar Arena) and all 51 pages (17 x DPS/healer/tank) were fetched, HTTP 200, 0 failures. Result: every dungeon is complete at 40 tier rows, but only ONE of the nine raid bosses publishes anything - Nek'zali at 36 rows - and the other eight return empty tier lists across all three roles. That totals 356 tier rows against 619 stored. Rewriting the file with it would be a 42% row drop, past the 25% maxRowDropPct limit AND below the 440 rows.min floor, and would publish a Season-2 fight view with one of nine bosses in it. So the stored Season-1 file is left byte-identical, its season stamp stays "s1" and the Fight selector stays hidden - which is the honest state, because the data in the file IS Season 1. The page snapshots for the two Per- pages were deliberately NOT advanced: nothing was ingested, so claiming freshness there would green the staleness gate on data that did not move. Expect this to clear by itself: at Nek'zali's 36 rows a full nine-boss set plus the 320 dungeon rows is ~644, comfortably over the floor.

Unchanged and still empty at the source. The survivability read comes from the metric:"survivability" tierList on the three RAID aggregate pages, and on tonight's fetch all three returned 0 entries again - a ninth consecutive day - even though the throughput list on those same pages repopulated with 37 Season-2 entries tonight. So this is a genuine upstream gap inside an otherwise rebuilt page, not a parse failure, and the 40 stored survivability tiers are left byte-identical. The per-boss pages ARE partially populated (Nek'zali carries 26 survivability entries) and were explicitly NOT used: the 2026-08-21 measurement recorded in the refresh-metrics skill settles that per-boss survivability is a fight artifact (21 of 38 specs disagree between the only two populated bosses, 14 by two or more bands), coverage is 2 of 9 bosses, the only complete set is a world boss, and the sample is 1-2 parses. Page snapshot not advanced, for the same reason as archon-encounters.

"95th pct DPS (Mythic)" could have advanced tonight for the first time since 08-16 and was HELD BACK on purpose. The Season-2 raid rankings table repopulated with the throughput list: 24 of 27 DPS rows plus 6 tank rows, read from props.pageProps.page.specRankingsSection.table.data as always. Two things stopped the merge. (a) COVERAGE: Fire Mage, Frost Mage and Affliction Warlock have no row at all, so merging would leave 3 stale Season-1 DPS values sitting inside a 27-row series that metricRanks pools within (role, bracket, name) with NO provenance key - the same mixing failure the bloodmallet tier gate exists to stop, except with seasons instead of sim tiers, and it would rank a 12.0.7 number against 12.1 ones. (b) SAMPLE: the whole Mythic raid cut is 918 parses, 1 to 79 per spec (Assassination 1, Feral 2, Survival 3, Vengeance 3) against stored n in the hundreds, and page.totalParses still reads 0. The honest move is the bloodmallet precedent - adopt wholesale or not at all - so stored data is byte-identical and the coverage date correctly does not move. For the record the values ARE close, not wild: 37 rows move 0.6% to 32%, none near the 60% maxValueMovePct. Merge wholesale on the first night Archon covers all 27 DPS specs; the standing-red label on this requirement should be rewritten then, because its stated cause ("0 rows, totalParses 0") is no longer the reason.

"95th pct HPS (Mythic)" is in the same state as archon-metrics and is reported separately per the split-row rule rather than coupled to it. The healer raid page repopulated tonight with all 7 rows (Holy Paladin 36 parses, Preservation 35, Holy Priest 35, Resto Shaman 33, Resto Druid 17, Mistweaver 16, Discipline 15), so unlike the DPS cut this one is COMPLETE within its role and would not mix seasons inside its own rank pool. It is still held, for one reason: the whole raid rankings surface is one page family with one asOf, and merging the healer third while the DPS third stays 8 days stale would advance this requirement's coverage date while the same page's DPS rows sit at 08-16 - a green line drawn from half a table. The moves it would have made are 2% to 32% (Preservation 214,368 -> 282,481 the largest), all inside maxValueMovePct. Merge with the rest.

Refreshed and merged: 40/40 rows advanced. All three Season-2 M+ pages returned specRankingsSection.table.data populated (27/7/6), values read as integers to match the stored precision and n taken from each row's parses column. Movement is small and uniformly upward - max 3.5% (Fire Mage 2837 -> 2935), median under 1% - with parse counts rising on every row (page total 2,353,508 -> 3,082,472), which is the signature of a genuine recut rather than a re-clustering artifact. Coverage date advanced 2026-08-22 -> 2026-08-24.

Half the series refreshed and half was held, so the coverage date correctly does not move (the min-60th-freshest of 80 rows is still a raid row at 2026-08-16). The 40 M+ popularity rows were re-parsed and merged from the same specRankingsSection tables as the M+ score, shape-checked before merging exactly as the recipe requires: every value a plausible percentage, each of the three M+ role groups summing to 100.0 (300.0 across all three), and no row equal to that spec's M+ score - the check that caught DPS magnitudes landing under unit "%" in an earlier run. The 40 RAID popularity rows are available for the first time in three weeks but are held with archon-metrics, for the same coverage reason: three DPS specs have no row, so merging would mix Season-1 and Season-2 shares inside one series that must sum to 100 per role group - and a partial merge would not sum to anything. Values unchanged, byte-identical.

Both JSON API endpoints fetched with plain curl, no headers, no proxy, no auth; the wowmeta.com HTML is a stale prerender and was not touched. manifest.json returns snapshotDate 2026-08-11 and the rankings file carries Last-Modified: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 15:25:05 GMT - the two AGREE, which is what distinguishes tonight from the 2026-08-04 incident where a pinned manifest hid a moved payload. The payload was diffed rather than trusted to the manifest anyway: 44 blocks, the three whitelisted categoryTypes (dps/hps/tank, sortField lowerBound, keyRange undefined - never a blacklist, because melee and ranged are subsets of dps and would double-count 27 specs) give 27+7+6 = 40 rows, all 40 matched the roster byte-identically and ALL 40 lowerBound values are unchanged to 1 dp. Upstream is frozen, not our fetch; nothing to merge means the coverage date correctly does not move and the 13-day staleness red stands as the honest signal.

No WCL fetch by this agent: it holds no credentials and did not contact warcraftlogs.com by any transport, API or HTML. The row is written from the deterministic pre-agent step's wcl-fetch/evidence.json (attemptedAt 2026-08-24T11:04:51.168Z, this run), which reports verdict "rdps-broken": OAuth and GraphQL transport both healthy (rate limit 3600/hour, 1 point spent), and the single standing retry - characterRankings(metric: rdps) on encounter 3176 - returned HTTP 200 carrying a bare "Internal server error", so the redistributed-credit metric family is still broken upstream. evidence.landed is EMPTY and evidence.rawRecipes is empty, so nothing landed and no row may claim success. The five frozen rDPS/normalized cuts are therefore unreachable and the stored zone-46 medians stay byte-identical at 2026-08-10. This is the OWNER-ACCEPTED STANDING RED recorded in required-sources.json: there is no Season-2 fetch path for zone 53 while the HTML statistics transport is Cloudflare-challenged and the API rdps family 500s, and the red IS the honest staleness signal.

No WCL fetch by this agent (no credentials; warcraftlogs.com was not contacted by any means). Same evidence file and same verdict as wcl-live-raid - wcl-fetch/evidence.json, attemptedAt 2026-08-24T11:04:51.168Z, verdict "rdps-broken", landed {} - so the zone-55 M+ medians cannot advance and the stored zone-47 values stay byte-identical at 2026-08-10. Reported as its own row rather than coupled to the raid one so that a future partial restoration is visible per bracket. Owner-accepted standing red; it clears when a zone-55 recipe lands.

Fetched and parsed cleanly and UPSTREAM HAS RECUT, which is the difference from the last two nights. All three meta pages by plain browser-UA GET (r.jina.ai does not work on murlok), HTTP 200, 40-71 KB; entries split on the meta-item box, the spec name taken from the entry's own h3 and looked up whole against the roster, and the single value in the entry's stat list read as the rating. 27+7+6 = 40 rows, 0 unmatched. All three pages report "Updated 6-7 hours ago", and all 40 values moved: 26 of 27 DPS rose (Arms 3229 -> 3367, Arcane 3209 -> 3353, Windwalker 3071 -> 3241) while the bottom four fell (Frost Mage 2846 -> 2673 the largest drop), max move 6.3%, nothing near maxValueMovePct. Merged at asOf 2026-08-24 - murlok publishes only a relative "updated N hours ago", so the run date is the honest stamp here, unlike wowmeta and bloodmallet which publish their own. The number stays labelled a top-50 CEILING (the average rating of each spec's own best 50 players), never popularity.

All 27 DPS charts requested via talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk with up to 3 attempts each. 17 returned data and 10 returned the 76-byte {"status": "error"} body on every attempt - Havoc, Devourer, Balance, Feral, Augmentation, Devastation, Windwalker, Retribution, Arms and Fury, the EXACT set recorded as persistent on 2026-08-20, with control specs succeeding interleaved in the same minutes, so the endpoint is healthy and those ten simply have not been re-simmed. NOTHING WAS MERGED, and the reason is now sharper than "partial roster": all 17 available charts read simc_settings.tier = MID2 dated 2026-08-19, while all 26 stored profiles are MID1. Merging them would put two sim tiers in one source pool, which validate.mjs fails outright - and rightly, because fightLabels pools every DPS profile into one flat array with no provenance key and MID2 runs a measured mean 1.79x MID1, so the ST/cleave/AoE labels would publish "which specs bloodmallet has re-simmed" as spec strength. Adopt wholesale or not at all; "adopt what exists, null the rest" is separately blocked by the 15-row floor and the 19-of-26 row-drop floor. Stored data byte-identical, the 47-day staleness red stands, and the handoff is explicit: the night all 27 charts return MID2 is a wholesale adoption that WILL need a human value_move_ack, because MID2-vs-MID1 moves most rows far past maxValueMovePct.

The standing recipe ran and the answer is still hold-MID1, but the picture moved in the owner's favour and the requirement's stated reason is now out of date. MID1_Raid.txt is 272 bytes - a run that has just started, with no "DPS Ranking:" block - so the recipe falls through to MID1_Raid.html, which is still the COMPLETED 12.0.7.68974 Live report (hotfix 2026-08-06) that produced the stored values on 08-08; an unchanged report is the honest explanation for an unchanged parse, and nothing was merged. The news is on the MID2 side: MID2_Raid.html now self-identifies "12.1.0.69404 Live (hotfix 2026-08-22/69404, git build HEAD c357aef3e7)", so the PTR half of the 08-21 objection HAS CLEARED - it is a Live 12.1 report now, and MID1 is being regenerated at the same build right now. What has not cleared is completeness: MID2 carries 34 baseline profiles covering 18 DPS specs, with NO Druid and NO Evoker profiles at all and no Havoc, Devourer, Windwalker, Retribution, Arms or Fury - eight of the same ten specs bloodmallet cannot re-sim either, which suggests an upstream module rebuild rather than two independent outages. Holding MID1 keeps the series internally comparable; the honest cost is that the stored numbers are a 12.0.7 report three weeks after 12.1 shipped, and the 16-day red says so. OWNER NOTE: this requirement's label still says MID2 is "12.1.0.69382 PTR" - that is no longer true and the label should be rewritten to name completeness as the only remaining objection.

Fetched and parsed cleanly and the period HAS been recomputed. /period/latest 302s to /period/1077 (200, 199,856 bytes) and the body names it "Period 1077 MID2"; the parse is BOUNDED to the "Spec representation in top keys" section and ends at the next h2, which is what keeps the "Classes and specs" block and the per-dungeon sections from inflating 40 rows to 59. Labels normalised on [-\s]+ in both directions ("devourer demon-hunter" -> roster) and the value taken from the span AFTER the bar, never the bar's own height style. 39 rows parsed, 0 unmatched, 33 of them moved (Arcane 10.6 -> 11.7, Arms 11.7 -> 12.7, Blood DK 12.4 -> 13.0, Prot Paladin 3.5 -> 2.6, Havoc 1.2 -> 0.6). The series identity check passed before merging: total 100.3% with role subtotals DPS 60.1 / Tank 20.0 / Healer 20.2, i.e. the representation SHARE column and not the /meta per-key-presence figure that measures 7-10x higher. The 40th spec is Fire Mage, which the chart omits entirely - its stored value is already 0 and it was deliberately left at its own 2026-08-22 date rather than being written as a dated zero, because "absent from the chart" is an upstream absence and inventing a measurement for it would be a guess. Coverage date advanced 2026-08-22 -> 2026-08-24.

Every channel swept cleanly and there was NOTHING NEW TO LOG - the feed's newest entry is unchanged at 2026-08-22, so success here means the watch completed, not that new data landed. Three live channels: the Wowhead news RSS (40 items, parsed per <item> block and never by tag adjacency, bodies free in content:encoded, newest Sun 23 Aug 19:56 CDT), the news INDEX payload data.news.newsData (20 posts, anchored on the id attribute and brace-balanced, newest id 382495) and the blue-tracker payload data.blueTracker.default (66 KB, 50 entries, 44 unique topics after deduping by topic id, newest 2026-08-22 22:58). Nothing about a 12.2 PTR realm, thread or announcement in any of them: all 40 RSS bodies were scanned for "12.2", "next major patch", "PTR is now available", "PTR Development Notes" and "Public Test Realm" - zero hits. Dev-notes thread 2317811 re-polled and still at highest post 19 (Linxy, 2026-07-31), the closed cycle's expected silence. Three canonical forum posts were re-polled for in-place EDITS rather than assumed static: the running hotfix topic 2336376 post #1 is still v15 with updated_at 2026-08-22T01:46:38Z (so no August 22 or 23 hotfix section has been added), "Class Tuning Incoming - August 25" (2339812) post #1 is still v1 and unedited since creation, so the logged 08-22 distillation is current and needed no amendment, and the Altar of Fangs and Item Adjustment topics are dungeon and item tuning. Swept and correctly NOT logged, each read rather than judged by title: news=382566 "Patch 12.1 Hotfixes for August 21st" (body read in full - Delves, Dungeons and Raids, Housing, Items, Prey, and ZERO class or spec lines, so a kind:"hotfix" entry would carry an empty specsAffected/highlights pair and reach no drawer), news=382564 "Concealed Pistol in Murder Row" (a Murder Row dungeon-item guide), the Mythic Nymrissa nerf and the Evoker disconnect acknowledgement (encounter tuning and a bug, no values), and the Race-to-World-First day recaps. The only value-bearing class line anywhere on or after 08-21 is the already-logged 08-22 tuning post. No set bonus was touched by anything tonight, so no spec.tierSet needed advancing. PTR zone sweeps (54/52/56/57) remain dormant between cycles and were not attempted; their contract rows were removed at the flip.

A full sweep AND the first distillation night in three: 4 videos distilled into 14 takes and 14 metaNotes, 1 transcript-verified skip. DISCOVERY: 44 unique YouTube channels polled (41 class-lane + 3 general), every one HTTP 200 on the FIRST attempt, 0 feed errors, no backoff needed. The seen-set was rebuilt from the four structured lanes (seen[] + skipped[] + videos[] + the youtu.be ids cited in takes/metaNotes = 1,191 ids), never from log prose; 660 feed entries yielded 117 unseen inside the cycle bound 2026-06-18 (the OLDEST date in ptr-builds.json, derived with Math.min rather than indexed), 0 unseen predating it. DISTILLED from transcript-fetch/ (summary.json verdict "ok", requested 5, fetched 5): leak's "Survival Hunter is DOOMED" into a raid and an M+ take (his 4%-is-not-enough argument rests on Survival already holding its Season 2 tier set through a now-fixed bug, so it gains nothing at the reset while the specs above it do); Obli's Frost DK follow-up into a raid take (7.3% package, welcome but does not move a tier he calls unfriendly to both DK specs) and an M+ take (closes the ~10% gap to Unholy), plus an Unholy M+ take on the Blightful-over-Rider consistency argument; YoDaTV's M+ tier-list update into nine takes inside his registered scope (Vengeance to A+ and frontrunner for tank damage, Blood DK still the tankiest tank with the key-22 one-shot speculation rejected, Guardian next after VDH, Retribution up to A+, Brewmaster / Prot Warrior / Prot Paladin left low, Arms and Holy Paladin held in the top group) - every one of his out-of-scope reads (rogues, shaman, Windwalker, mages, warlocks, hunters, evokers, Mistweaver, Feral) was left undistilled; and izen's "FIRST Buffs & Nerfs of Season 2" into 14 metaNotes on the August 25 pass, era-framed "Season 2 live" and NOT "Season 2 PTR". SUPERSEDED 16 records within the same lens only - 12 takes (leak's 07-24 directional Survival read, Obli's 08-20 Frost and 08-06 Unholy, and one per YoDaTV spec) and 4 izen general-lens metaNotes; his bracket-scoped 08-16 M+ and 08-17 raid sets are a different lens and stay live. SKIPPED 1 to the durable lane: Kalamazi's xg5sxI6LspI, which is the 3h24m unedited stream VOD of the same day as BdzA4HWaUSc - every Warlock read in it is already carried by the four takes distilled from the edited video and is thinner here, so distilling would duplicate one creator, spec, date and lens with a weaker source. RETIRED 3 ids to seen[] as durable scope dismissals only (czPW0XwrzhQ, Pq9NJVn-SQc, sb7LNHsCD2Q - all explicit PvP in the title, which is out of scope for this PvE tracker). QUEUED 2 for the next drain, keyword-filtered as the nightly lane requires against the 100-request monthly budget: qG-So9pnRBQ (MadSkillzzTV, healer M+ and raid on Holy Paladin and Preservation) and 3E_EY7ULmkw (Dalaran Gaming, the August 25 patch notes). The other ~110 unseen stay UNSEEN on purpose - launch-week stream VODs, boss and dungeon guides, RWF day recaps and Supatease clip-shaped uploads whose media:description merely repeats the title - so the next run reconsiders every one of them. No creator showed coverage outside their registered specs, so nothing is flagged for a scope widening. yt-dlp was not invoked: the settled 2026-07-17 datacenter bot wall makes it useless from a runner, and nothing was installed or upgraded. latest advanced for Obli, leak, YoDaTV (6 class entries, one channel) and izen, each to a video THIS run distilled.
